clue.text: Argument about leaving the parade ground

definitions.meaning: a quarrel between people who were friends
soldiers dismissed from their ranks on parade do this, in the drill-square command sense

explanation.surface: A row breaks out over who gets to quit the drill square first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' just joins the two senses: a quarrel, and the military order for troops to leave their line.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are idioms: a quarrel, and soldiers breaking ranks when dismissed from parade.

clue.text: Victory or defeat

definitions.meaning: a triumph or win over an enemy
the act of overcoming and subjugating someone, as in a conqueror's work

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about whether an outcome counts as winning or losing.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface sets the two words up as opposites, yet the same noun covers the winning and the overpowering of the loser.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun means both a triumph and the subjugation of the vanquished side.

clue.text: Fine quality diamonds worn with shirt in New York

indicators.note: the diamonds and shirt sit within the letters for New York

parts.note: ice is slang for diamonds
T as in T-shirt

explanation.surface: A fashion item: fine gems paired with a shirt in Manhattan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'worn with' is padding for the surface: the gems go alongside the shirt, and both sit within the city's initials.
explanation.definitionFit: A nicety is a subtle distinction or fine detail, a refinement.

clue.text: False witness who turns up to abuse

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up means the word for abuse is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: to rail at someone is to abuse them verbally

explanation.surface: A perjurer who shows up in court to hurl insults.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone giving false testimony is telling untruths, so is a fibber.

clue.text: Indifference of some soldiers

definitions.meaning: a unit of troops sent away from the main body on a special task

explanation.surface: Apathy shown by a group of troops.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both emotional aloofness and a body of troops split off for a mission.

clue.text: Don't totally accept the cut-price offer

definitions.meaning: to disregard or take with a pinch of salt

explanation.surface: Advice to be sceptical about a bargain sale.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to disregard partly; as a noun it is a price reduction.

clue.text: Various trees but no great variety

definitions.text: Various trees but no great variety

parts.words: Various trees but no great variety
parts.note: many kinds of tree can be grown this way, but none of them grows large: 'great' means big, not wide-ranging

explanation.surface: A complaint that a range of trees offers little choice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'no great variety' reads as little choice, but means no large kind: these are dwarfed trees of many species.
explanation.definitionFit: This Japanese art grows miniature trees of many species, none of them large.

clue.text: Found out, Eddy coloured

indicators.note: the letters of the name are discovered rearranged, set out in another order

explanation.surface: Eddy has been caught, and he has been painted.
explanation.definitionFit: Fabric or hair that has been tinted with a dye has been coloured.

clue.text: Australian with ancestry in Lincoln?

indicators.note: the ancestry word sits inside the president's nickname

parts.note: Abe was the nickname of US president Abraham Lincoln
origin means descent or ancestry

explanation.surface: Asks about an Australian with family roots in Lincoln, the English city.
explanation.walkthrough: Lincoln looks like the English city but is the president, AB(ORIGIN)E.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a member of Australia's first peoples, so an Australian by birth.

clue.text: Cream and gold seen in plant

indicators.note: the heraldic gold is placed within the climbing plant

parts.note: ivy is a climbing plant
or is the heraldic term for gold

explanation.surface: Cream and gold colours spotted in a plant's flowers.
explanation.walkthrough: I(OR)VY.
explanation.definitionFit: This is an off-white shade, close to the colour of cream.

clue.text: Fifty-one line up endlessly on right for a drink

parts.note: LI is 51 in Roman numerals

indicators.note: the final letter of the word for lining up is dropped

parts.note: to queue is to line up

explanation.surface: Fifty-one people stand in line for the bar on the right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' drops the final E of QUEUE, leaving QUEU.
explanation.definitionFit: A sweet flavoured spirit such as Cointreau is an after-dinner tipple.

clue.text: Denounced a cricket club not new to exploitation

parts.note: second-hand, and exploited, both meanings of used

explanation.surface: A cricket club that has long been exploited makes a complaint.
explanation.definitionFit: To be accused is to be charged or blamed, i.e. publicly condemned.

clue.text: One wants to be so described

definitions.text: One wants to be so described

parts.words: One wants to be so described
parts.note: 'wants' means lacks rather than desires: someone in want is poor

explanation.surface: A person craving a particular label.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wants' looks like desire, but here means lacking, so one who wants is poor.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone in want, lacking necessities, is described as poor and deprived.

clue.text: Providing people with different occupations

parts.note: 'occupations' means homes people occupy, not jobs

explanation.surface: A careers service finding people new jobs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'occupations' suggests jobs, but means dwellings occupied: people are given new homes.
explanation.definitionFit: Moving people into new accommodation gives them a different place to occupy.

clue.text: Preparing for the night?

parts.note: the night is the opening night of a play, which actors prepare for

explanation.surface: Getting ready for bed.
explanation.walkthrough: The night is a theatre's opening night, not bedtime.
explanation.definitionFit: Actors practise their parts before a play's opening performance.

clue.text: Some grates designed as fuel-savers

indicators.note: the letters are designed into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Some fireplace grates are built to economise on fuel.
explanation.definitionFit: These large tanks store town gas, so they hold and keep a fuel.

clue.text: Riches of the arts, perhaps, for personal adornment

indicators.note: perhaps tells us these letters could be put another way

explanation.surface: Artistic treasures serve as finery for the individual.
explanation.definitionFit: Plumes from the big flightless bird were prized decorations for hats and costume.

clue.text: Doing nothing but fighting?

definitions.meaning: read as two words, ... describes troops in combat

explanation.surface: A query whether someone is idle or at war.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that the second sense needs the word split into IN ACTION.
explanation.definitionFit: Idleness is the plain sense; split in two it means engaged in combat.

clue.text: Lugs around old currency reserves

indicators.note: the hearing organs go around the coin

parts.note: lugs is British slang for ears
the mark was Germany's currency before the euro

explanation.surface: Ears around old money kept in reserve.
explanation.walkthrough: EAR(MARK)S.
explanation.definitionFit: To set aside funds for a purpose is to allocate or set them apart.

clue.text: Scold or nag — matter put straight

indicators.note: putting things straight means rearranging the letters into order

explanation.surface: Advice to tell someone off or complain until a matter is settled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'or' is a link word; the fodder is NAG and MATTER together.
explanation.definitionFit: A termagant is a quarrelsome, overbearing woman: a shrew or harridan.

clue.text: Fruit is seen in the fall

indicators.note: the little word appears within the rainfall

parts.note: rain is what falls from the sky

explanation.surface: Fruit found on the ground in autumn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the fall' tempts as American autumn; it is rainfall, RA(IS)IN.
explanation.definitionFit: A dried grape is a fruit.

clue.text: Return of spirit in open discussion

indicators.note: return turns the little word back on itself

parts.note: rum is a spirit

explanation.surface: Debate over bringing back liquor, or a ghost's return.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Return' reverses OF to FO.
explanation.definitionFit: A forum is a meeting or medium for public debate.

clue.text: One won't be the first to do it

definitions.text: One won't be the first to do it

parts.words: One won't be the first to do it
parts.note: whoever comes after another, rather than leading, does this

explanation.surface: A hesitant remark from someone unwilling to go first.
explanation.definitionFit: To come after someone means going second, never leading.

clue.text: Flies east via resorts

indicators.note: re-sorts, sorting the letters again into a new order

explanation.surface: A traveller flies east by way of holiday resorts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resorts' looks like holiday places but reads as re-sorts.
explanation.definitionFit: To pilot or travel in an aircraft is to fly.

clue.text: Saucy curve

definitions.meaning: a curved structure, as over a doorway

explanation.surface: A cheeky bend.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means roguish; as a noun a bow-shaped span.

clue.text: Dashing fellow who went to the top at sea

definitions.text: Dashing fellow who went to the top at sea

parts.words: Dashing fellow who went to the top at sea
parts.note: a brave, chivalrous man, and the ... sail or mast is the uppermost on a sailing ship

explanation.surface: A brave sailor who climbed the rigging.
explanation.walkthrough: The topgallant, shortened to gallant, is the sail or mast above the topmast on a square-rigger.
explanation.definitionFit: A brave, chivalrous man is gallant, and the topgallant is set highest at sea.

clue.text: Turn pale, not having a costume

indicators.note: the letter a is left out of the phrase

parts.note: to go wan is to turn pale

explanation.surface: Someone goes pale on finding they have nothing to wear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not having a' removes the A from GO WAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A long formal dress or robe is an outfit worn on display.

clue.text: Company about to broadcast somewhere in Egypt

indicators.note: the company letters go about the word for broadcast

parts.note: to air a programme is to broadcast it

explanation.surface: A firm planning to transmit from a place in Egypt.
explanation.walkthrough: C(AIR)O.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the capital city of Egypt, so a place there.

clue.text: Fresh delivery of an American magazine

parts.note: new means fresh
a yorker is a cricket delivery pitched right at the batsman's feet

explanation.surface: A new issue of a US magazine is delivered.
explanation.walkthrough: A yorker is a ball bowled in cricket that lands at the batter's feet.
explanation.definitionFit: The New Yorker is a famous US weekly periodical.
